method: CDP heap snapshots after GC, L1/L6/L1/L6/L1; 12 rendered frames per load
strongRetainer: window.__SS__ -> Game -> GameView.renderer -> _nodes.nodeBuilderCache -> NodeBuilderState.bindings -> uniforms -> NodeUniform
cleanup: At level unload retire render objects, node data, render lists and render contexts; delete fallback VAOs. During async warm-up use the actual RenderObject.context as the shared-binding cache key.
additionalRetainer: Three NodeBuilder._bindingGroupsCache: async compileAsync restores _currentRenderContext before getForRenderAsync, so bindings are keyed by the persistent renderer. A debug.onNodeBuilderCreated hook scopes _getBindGroup to the actual render context.
nodeResetOnly: NodeManager.dispose alone did not meet the heap gate; async cache-key correction and render-context retirement pass both tiers.
